tweaks.title: Enable NVAPI
tweaks.reason: NVIDIA GPU detected. Exposes NVAPI so DLSS, Reflex and some vendor checks work.

tweaks.title: Keep the NVIDIA shader cache
tweaks.reason: Stops the driver from pruning its cache, which causes stutter on every launch of large games.

tweaks.title: Report the GPU as AMD
tweaks.reason: For games that refuse to start or crash on NVIDIA-specific code paths.

tweaks.title: FSR 1 upscaling
tweaks.reason: AMD GPU detected. Upscales from a lower fullscreen resolution in older games (GE-Proton only).

tweaks.title: Use ntsync
tweaks.reason: /dev/ntsync is available. Kernel-level Windows sync primitives, faster and more correct than fsync.

tweaks.title: Run with GameMode
tweaks.reason: Feral GameMode is installed. Sets the CPU governor to performance while playing.

tweaks.title: Native Wayland
tweaks.reason: Wayland session detected. Bypasses XWayland: better frame pacing and HDR, but some games misbehave (Proton 10+/GE).

tweaks.title: Force D3D11
tweaks.reason: For crashes at startup in games with a D3D11 fallback.

tweaks.title: Use WineD3D instead of DXVK
tweaks.reason: For old D3D8/9 games with rendering glitches under DXVK. Slower.

tweaks.title: Write a Proton log
tweaks.reason: Saves $HOME/steam-<appid>.log, needed for any bug report.
